title: Ray-Ban RB3697 Wings II Square Sunglasses, Gold/Dark Green (Open Box)
writeup: Woot has the open-box Ray-Ban RB3697 Wings II square sunglasses (RB3697 905071, gold frame with dark green lenses, size 35-35-140) for $37.10.
